about: Twin Blooms 并蒂: named combos between two heroines. A Twin Bloom is active while both are on the team; 'members' lists the pair, 'thread' the Karmic Thread they already share (if any), 'trigger' and 'effects' use the same vocabulary as techniques, and 'howTo' is the hint shown in Formation.

records.name: Sun and Moon
records.text: When Ten Suns over Fusang and The Cold Palace Descends are cast in the same turn, the second becomes an Eclipse: +50% damage, and every enemy it hits is Soul Shocked for 1 turn.
records.howTo: Line up both ultimates. Gui Chanjuan can go second without costing a chain once Moon Palace Solitude keeps her outside Harmony.

records.name: Reflected Florets
records.text: When Bai Lingbo's reflection recasts one of Shang Jianlan's techniques, it strikes at full power instead of 60%. A reflected Thousand Florets, One Edge keeps climbing: its seven strikes start at +70%.
records.howTo: Cast Shang Jianlan's ultimate, then Bai Lingbo's straight after. Metal feeds Water, so the pair is also a Harmony link.

records.name: Sweet Poison
records.text: Every Heart Demon stack counts as a separate debuff for She Qingzhu's damage bonuses. When Heart Demon turns an enemy against its ally, the strike also passes all its Gu Venom to that ally.
records.howTo: Stack Heart Demon with Fox-Fire Rose, then poison the field with Sweet Oleander Mist. Fire feeds Earth: Hu Qiangwei, then She Qingzhu.

records.name: Wind and Thunder
records.text: When Wen Xingyu's area technique hits, Gu Youlan follows up on the first enemy hit for 60% ATK, and each follow-up gives Wen Xingyu 3 Haste. Gu Youlan deals 20% more damage to Entangled enemies.
records.howTo: Both are Wood: cast them back to back for Kindred Qi, and let Thunder Wakes the Insects Entangle the field first.

records.name: Hundred Flowers Banquet
records.text: An ally shielded by Wei Zi also gains Ying Wucai's current colour for 1 turn (Metal Sword Intent, Wood Wind Step, Water Lotus Dew, Fire Surging Qi, Earth Iron Body). When one of Wei Zi's shields breaks, Ying Wucai heals that ally for 50% of the shield's value.
records.howTo: Shield first, colour second: Queen of a Hundred Flowers becomes a buff for the whole team.

records.name: Moonlight Takes Colour
records.text: Gui Chanjuan's techniques take the phase that overcomes the most living enemies, as moonlight takes the hydrangea's colour. The borrowed phase also sets her Phase Qi.
records.howTo: Bring them against mixed waves: every area technique strikes with advantage where it counts.

records.name: The Queen's Thorns
records.text: An enemy Provoked by Wei Zi gains a Heart Demon stack each time it hits her. Each time Heart Demon turns an enemy against its ally, the team gains 1 Spirit Qi.
records.howTo: Unbowed Before the Empress Provokes every enemy, and their blows feed the charm. Fire feeds Earth: Hu Qiangwei, then Wei Zi.

records.name: Golden Crow, Vermilion Phoenix
records.text: When Ten Suns over Fusang hits a burning enemy, its Fire Poison burns all its remaining damage at once, and Yan Feihong's ultimate comes 1 turn closer.
records.howTo: Burn first with Scarlet Inferno, then raise the ten suns. Both are Fire: back-to-back casts build Kindred Qi.

records.name: Moonlit Jasmine
records.text: Karmic Marks from either of them last 1 turn longer. Wu Gang's Endless Axe grows one extra step (+10%) for each Karmic-Marked enemy it hits.
records.howTo: Ning Suxin marks the field with Fragrance Fills the Garden, and Gui Chanjuan's axe grows twice as fast. A 3★ who makes a 5★ shine.

records.name: Snow on Still Water
records.text: When Bai Lingbo reflects Thousand-Year Snow Lotus, the reflection Frost Seals every enemy it hits. While both stand, every Frost Seal that breaks gives the team 1 Spirit Qi, with no limit per turn.
records.howTo: Cast Xue Lianxin's ultimate, then Bai Lingbo's. Both are Water: Kindred Qi.

records.name: Ten Thousand Cuts
records.text: Every strike of Thousand Florets, One Edge breaks 1 extra Qi shield segment. When Li Qianshu Shatters a boss's Qi shield, Shang Jianlan's ultimate is ready at once.
records.howTo: For bosses: Li Qianshu's needles crack the shield, then Shang Jianlan climbs into the Shattered boss.

records.name: Thorns in the Night
records.text: Mo Yingyue's critical hits add a Heart Demon stack. Hu Qiangwei's techniques add 1 extra Heart Demon stack to Soul Shocked enemies.
records.howTo: Heaven's Execution Soul Shocks, then Rose of the Crimson Moon charms in one stroke. Wood feeds Fire: Mo Yingyue, then Hu Qiangwei.

records.name: Poison into Medicine
records.text: Each time Gu Venom ticks on an enemy, Ju Yannian turns 30% of the damage into healing for the most injured ally. When Every Petal a Poison makes the venom burst, every ally recovers 15% of the damage.
records.howTo: She Qingzhu poisons, Ju Yannian brews it into medicine: a sustain team without a second healer.

records.name: Plum and Orchid
records.text: When Ling Shuang's single-target technique hits, Gu Youlan follows up for 60% ATK (once per turn). Her follow-ups never break Frost Seal, so Ling Shuang's finisher still counts it.
records.howTo: Ling Shuang freezes, Gu Youlan rides the wind behind her. Water feeds Wood: Ling Shuang, then Gu Youlan.

records.name: Peach and Apricot
records.text: Entangles from either of them last 1 turn longer. Spring Thunder deals 50% more damage to Entangled enemies.
records.howTo: Door God's Ward Entangles, and Wen Xingyu's thunder does the rest. Both are Wood: Kindred Qi.

records.name: Frost and Thunder
records.text: When Mo Yingyue hits a Frost Sealed enemy, the seal shatters for +60% damage instead of +30%, and the enemy is Soul Shocked for 1 turn.
records.howTo: Freeze with Ling Shuang, then strike with Mo Yingyue. Water feeds Wood, so the pair is also a Harmony link.

records.name: Phoenix Among Peonies
records.text: When a burning enemy hits Wei Zi, its Fire Poison flares and deals all its remaining damage at once. Yan Feihong's Fire Poison lasts 1 turn longer on enemies Wei Zi has Provoked.
records.howTo: Scarlet Inferno burns the field and Unbowed Before the Empress Provokes it: every blow against Wei Zi detonates. Fire feeds Earth: Yan Feihong, then Wei Zi.

records.name: Returned Karma
records.text: Each debuff Su Lianhua removes from an ally lands on the enemy with the fewest debuffs, and the team gains 1 Spirit Qi for each (up to 2 a turn).
records.howTo: Let the Netherflame Sect land its burns and venom, then Jade Lotus Revival sends them home.

records.name: The Crabapple Sleeps
records.text: Xuan Wangyou's Lotus Dream chances rise by 25%. Tang Mian deals 30% more damage to dreaming enemies, and the blow that wakes them Body Shatters them for 1 turn.
records.howTo: Send them to sleep, then wake them with a greatsword. A pair of 3★ and 4★ heroines for any team.

records.name: Red Fire Season
records.text: An enemy that hits Du Tihong gains a Sword Wound stack. Thousand Seeds Burst also makes the target's Fire Poison burn all its remaining damage at once.
records.howTo: Du Tihong draws the blows and plants the wounds; Zhu Liuhuo bursts them. Both are Fire: Kindred Qi.
